text_8850dd43: It is designed for appointment-based businesses such as consultancies, studios and personal care providers. A suitable workflow depends on the services you offer and how you work.
text_9e76d80a: How does it fit the way I work?
text_4f67c01e: A workflow is planned around your team, service durations and availability. Use the form to describe your current process, difficulties and the steps you want to improve.
text_44043b35: What happens after I request a demo?
text_8f02d352: Your request is saved and confirmation appears only after a successful save. This is a service enquiry; it does not create an appointment or account. A meeting is not automatically scheduled here.
text_f26ff20b: Is it suitable for solo businesses?
text_6e127b45: Availability and service durations matter for solo businesses too. Let us know that you work alone so a workflow without unnecessary team steps can be considered.
text_58d35838: What if I have several locations?
text_93d67eb5: Each location may have different hours, teams and services. Include the number of locations and your shared management needs. Multi-location support must be confirmed separately.
text_8619895d: What problem does it aim to solve?
text_8c308f82: It aims to organise appointments scattered across calls, messages and calendars. Whether your priority is scheduling conflicts, cancellations or team coordination will shape the workflow.
text_1f14b6b7: No technical knowledge is needed to describe your needs or submit the form. Explain your daily work in your own words. Setup requirements depend on the agreed solution.
text_3e0a66aa: Can I book an appointment on this page?
text_f6db8014: This form lets businesses request information about the service. It does not book customer appointments. Describe the booking process you would like for your business.
text_82daa12f: Does the calendar show real records?
text_6a6229e6: The calendar and animated cards use fictional content to illustrate the workflow. They do not display real customer information or create appointments.
text_c6c59eac: Do I need to replace my entire workflow?
text_1358e8f4: The first step is understanding your current process. Discuss what should stay and what could improve. Keeping existing tools or migrating should be considered during scoping.
text_16f85547: A consultation and a longer service can take different amounts of time. Share service names and average durations to help plan slots. Duration rules must be agreed during setup.
text_d03d4537: How do you plan preparation time between appointments?
text_570e9aed: Cleaning, preparation or note-taking may require a gap between appointments. Explain which services need a buffer and how long it should be. Including this time in availability needs to be assessed.
text_18508781: What if my opening hours vary each day?
text_c62fe084: Share opening and closing times for each day. Variable hours, lunch breaks and exceptional dates need separate rules. Accurate information is essential for planning.
text_33b39bb7: How are holidays and closed days handled?
text_e5d87664: Public holidays, leave and business closures are part of availability planning. Explain how you manage them now. Closed-day rules will be considered in the scope.
text_6a6eb9f9: Can I define an appointment cancellation deadline?
text_c6f2d866: Cancellation deadlines depend on your service. You may want different rules for same-day cancellations. Share your preferred policy; this page does not enforce a cancellation policy.
text_6b6f8312: How are appointment time changes planned?
text_f7255497: Rescheduling involves availability, service duration and notifying the customer. Explain who should be allowed to change appointments to help define the workflow.
text_82ce0ae2: How do you handle double bookings?
text_6acebd82: Conflicts depend on staff and resource capacity as well as time. Share how many services you can provide at once. Conflict prevention must be verified in the selected solution.
text_f9e03485: Is it suitable for group classes or sessions?
text_b90f0cbd: Group bookings allow several participants in one slot. Capacity and booking rules differ from individual appointments. Mention this need explicitly so support can be assessed.
text_eb6e761e: Regular appointments need a frequency and end date. Decide whether a cancellation affects one session or the entire series. Recurrence support is confirmed during scoping.
text_72c1c45c: Managing customers waiting for full slots and notifying them of openings requires a separate workflow. Describe your needs in the form. There is no active waitlist on this page.
text_a4b13968: The channel and timing depend on your business. Contact details and permissions are also part of the plan. This form does not send automated customer reminders.
text_96acf725: Share your expected monthly message volume and destination countries. Providers, integrations and message costs need separate assessment. This page has no active SMS connection.
text_cfae702c: Include your WhatsApp needs in your enquiry. Integration, account requirements and message templates need assessment. Do not assume an active WhatsApp integration is included here.
text_ed4affb0: Email reminders require a sender address, content and timing, plus handling for delivery failures. Entering your email in this form does not mean an automatic email will be sent.
text_4d4bc463: How far in advance should reminders be sent?
text_57ff9ddb: Timing depends on the service and the preparation customers need. Share preferences such as a day or a few hours before. Exact timing and repeat reminders are agreed during scoping.
text_3e4bc87c: Prepare examples with your business name, service information and preferred tone. Variable fields need to be agreed. Describe the content without sharing real customer details.
text_ea9c2177: Confirmation links and reply-based confirmation require different workflows. Explain your preferred method and what should happen without a response. This page does not collect appointment confirmations.
text_aea3fa6f: Invalid addresses, phone numbers and provider errors need tracking and retry rules. Specify who should see failures. Actual delivery behaviour must be verified with the integration.
text_4c44e91d: Required notifications and optional preferences should be clearly defined. Share your preference-management needs. Consent and communication settings require separate assessment.
text_4b66c0f6: What can be done about no-shows?
text_3a5c351c: Marking no-shows, rescheduling and follow-up messages require different rules. Describe your existing approach. No particular reduction in no-shows or outcome is guaranteed.
text_7c512cf0: Team members may have different skills and hours. Share your team size and the services each person provides. Separate calendars and shared views need to be scoped.
text_e34f9547: Can services be assigned to specific employees?
text_f4ef294d: Not every employee provides every service. Share who handles each service and which resources they need. Service-to-staff assignment rules must be agreed.
text_17b3af18: Will team members only see their own appointments?
text_73f8c1b3: Visibility depends on your responsibilities. Specify what managers, reception staff and team members should access. Role-based access must be confirmed separately.
text_752a4534: Leave may require blocking new bookings and reviewing existing appointments. Share how early leave is entered and who manages the changes.
text_377edb46: Does room or equipment availability matter?
text_4dac2293: If a service needs a particular room or piece of equipment, checking staff availability is not enough. List shared resources and their capacity. Resource scheduling support needs assessment.
text_2fa7a43b: Can I use it on a phone?
text_91e3177c: This landing page and request form adapt to mobile screens. Share mobile requirements for management tools separately. A mobile-friendly landing page does not imply a dedicated mobile app exists.
text_4ff25e95: Do I need to download an app?
text_e9a00a2f: No app is required to view this page or submit a request. The service environment and any app requirements depend on the chosen solution.
text_8f2d6693: Can I use it without internet?
text_ebfbe0f8: An internet connection is required to save a request; without one, the save cannot be confirmed. Share any offline management needs separately. Offline operation is not guaranteed here.
text_298eaa39: What if I need multiple languages?
text_edf9ffd8: You can switch this page between Turkish and English using the navigation controls. Tell us which languages your business and customers need; multilingual management tools require separate scoping.
text_2bdd6ce3: How are team training and setup support defined?
text_a5a4ef7e: Training depends on team size and existing habits. Share user roles and your preferred training format. Support channels, timing and content need to be agreed.
text_2dc9f5bd: Can it connect to Google Calendar?
text_7e14db08: Describe whether you need one-way transfer or two-way sync with Google Calendar. Account permissions and conflict rules need assessment. This page has no active Google Calendar connection.
text_7c76c29b: Can it work with Outlook Calendar?
text_3a1f335d: If you use Outlook or Microsoft 365, share the account type and sync requirements. Organisational permissions and data flow need review. Do not assume an Outlook connection is already active.
text_388d4d71: Can I add it to my existing website?
text_88879215: A link, embedded form and separate booking page are different options. Share your website platform and desired experience. The integration method requires assessment.
text_ebb8e066: Can I import my existing customer list?
text_fe804830: File format and data quality need review before import. Do not send real customer lists in an initial enquiry; describe the format and approximate record count. This form does not import data.
text_1b6f99bf: Specify which data, how often and in which format you need it. Reports and full data exports are different requirements. Export support and scope must be agreed.
text_ce23b20c: Can I accept online payments or deposits?
text_8d192369: Payment providers, currencies, refunds and cancellation rules require separate integration. Include any deposit requirements in your enquiry. This page takes no payments and asks for no card details.
text_c3c6fae7: How do I request a CRM or accounting integration?
text_4d16d546: Name the software and describe the information to transfer. An integration cannot be promised before checking APIs and permissions. Do not share passwords or access keys in the initial enquiry.
text_28806336: What information should I enter in the form?
text_eea4cf69: Enter your first and last name, email, selected service and a description of your needs. Use fictional test data only. Do not include passwords, payment details or real customer records.
text_ea197d2f: Successful requests are saved in a persistent server-side database. A success message appears only after the server confirms the save. Refreshing the page does not delete a saved request.
text_323d3420: What are the backup and data retention periods?
text_ab4bca17: Backup frequency, retention and deletion processes must be defined in service terms. No service-level or production-data retention commitment is published here. Clarify your expectations during scoping.
text_dbfef026: Needs, team size and integrations affect scope. No package prices are published on this page. Share your expectations to clarify scope and pricing terms.
text_ad84288: Does submitting a request cost anything?
text_6cd625a6: This form does not request payment or card details, and submitting it is not a purchase. Any service fees and terms must be agreed separately. No subscription starts when you submit.
text_4701932: Will a free trial account be created?
text_c3b2f344: Submitting the form does not automatically create a trial account or business dashboard. It is an information request. Mention any trial-environment expectations in your description.
text_a8ffa6a: How soon will I hear back?
text_be26a144: No response time is promised on this page. The success message confirms storage of the request, not a scheduled meeting or sent email.
text_cc9c15dc: Timing depends on the workflow, data migration and integrations. Share your preferred start date. A firm setup date cannot be given before the scope is defined.
text_9595519f: What should I write in the description?
text_637c4484: Describe your business type, team size, appointment volume and the step you find difficult. Use a fictional example of your desired workflow. Avoid unnecessary personal or sensitive details.
text_a9bfd7df: Choose the closest match and explain the details below. Mention additional needs if you have several. Your selection does not confirm a purchase or technical scope.
text_9ede5f70: What should I do if the form fails?
text_8b42e9e6: Check field warnings and your connection. Without confirmation, no success message appears; your entries are kept so you can retry. If you have tried too often, wait a while.
text_fb3c70fe: Should I click again while it says sending?
text_587a8040: The button is disabled while a request is being sent. Wait for the result and retry if an error appears. After a success message, you do not need to submit the same request again.
text_73755d9d: What if I cannot find an answer?
text_12aaaba0: Try a shorter keyword or send your question through the form. This search finds prepared answers; it is not a chatbot that generates new ones.
